label: Bible Study
prompt: And I will make of thee a great _____, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verse: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
note: God's call to Abram — one childless old man, promised a great nation and a great name.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I _____ you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verse: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
note: From your first day to your hoar hairs, God promises to carry you — no retirement age on this one.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as _____, and so we were in their sight.
verse: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
note: Ten of the twelve spies saw giants and felt like grasshoppers — and that self-image cost Israel forty years.

label: Deep Water
prompt: There is no fear in love; but perfect love _____ out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verse: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
note: John's fear diagnostic: fear expects punishment, and grown-up love has nothing left to dread.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, _____, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verse: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
note: 'Stedfast, unmoveable' — two KJV spellings in a row that spellcheck would flag. Paul's charge after the resurrection chapter.
